patterns: Can I check my delivery status?
responses: You can track your order status in real time by logging into your account under 'My Orders' or providing your Order ID here.
To check shipment status, please enter your 8-digit Order Number, or check the tracking link sent to your registered email.

patterns: How do I return an item?
How many days do I have to return?
responses: We offer a hassle-free 30-day return policy! Items must be unused, in original packaging with tags intact. Initiate returns in your account portal.
Returns are free within 30 days of delivery. Simply go to Account > Returns, print the prepaid label, and drop off your package at any authorized parcel point.

patterns: Can I exchange for a different size?
I got the wrong size, can I replace it?
responses: Yes! We offer free size and color exchanges within 14 days of delivery, subject to inventory availability.
To initiate an exchange, go to 'My Orders' > 'Exchange Item' and select your preferred replacement size or color.

patterns: What payment methods do you accept?

responses: We accept Visa, MasterCard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Cash on Delivery (COD in select regions).
You can securely pay via Credit/Debit Cards, PayPal, UPI/Net Banking, Apple Pay, and Buy-Now-Pay-Later (Klarna/Afterpay).

patterns: What are your store operating hours?
responses: Our physical retail stores are open Monday through Saturday from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM, and Sunday from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
Store hours: Mon-Sat (9am - 9pm), Sun (10am - 6pm). Our online store and AI support operate 24/7!
Standard shipping is FREE on all orders over $50! For orders under $50, standard delivery is $4.99. Express 2-day delivery is $9.99.
Enjoy Free Delivery on orders exceeding $50. Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days.

patterns: Do you have a physical store in London/New York?
responses: We have over 50 flagship stores across major cities. Use our Store Locator widget on the website to find the store closest to your zip code!

patterns: Are there any promo codes available?

patterns: How to cancel a placed order?
responses: Orders can be canceled within 1 hour of placement directly from 'My Orders' tab. After 1 hour, processing begins and you can request a return upon delivery.
To request an immediate cancellation, go to Account > Active Orders > Cancel. If already shipped, you can refuse package delivery.
We apologize for the inconvenience! Please upload a picture of the damaged item in 'My Orders' > 'Report Damage' for an immediate free replacement or full refund.
If your item arrived defective or damaged, contact us with your Order ID and photo proof within 7 days for priority resolution.

patterns: How long is the warranty period?
responses: All electronic items come with a standard 1-year manufacturer warranty covering hardware defects. Extended warranty options are available at checkout.
Warranty claims can be submitted via Account > Warranty Claims with your purchase invoice.

patterns: How to buy a digital gift card?
responses: Yes! Digital gift cards are available from $10 to $500. They are emailed instantly to the recipient and never expire.
You can redeem gift vouchers at online checkout or present the QR code at any of our retail store cash counters.

patterns: How is facial recognition data stored?
Do you store my face image?
responses: We prioritize customer privacy! Raw face images are NEVER stored. Only mathematical vector encodings (hash values) are stored in an encrypted database for loyalty check-ins. Consent can be revoked anytime.
Our facial recognition system is opt-in, GDPR/CCPA compliant, and encrypts all biometric encodings. You can opt-out or delete your biometric profile anytime.
